info.name: NW Track - Manual API requests
info.description: 157 normal requests in 22 folders. Collections return {items,page,size,totalElements}; use search/page/size. New users must change the initial password within seven days. See ../API_COLLECTIONS_AND_ACCOUNT_EXPIRY.md. No scripts. v21 supports independent module grants, custom roles, custom module placeholders and STYLE_CONFIGURATOR create/view-own. Use modules from login or auth/me for the sidebar. Copy returned roleCode, moduleKey, tokens and UUIDs manually. See ../ROLE_MODULES_V21.md and ../UI_V21_API_INTEGRATION.md.
